name: chalkscript-studio
description: Make and edit step-by-step explainers in ChalkScript Studio, which must be open on the same Mac.
long_description: Lets Claude read, edit, check and play the explainer documents of the project open in ChalkScript Studio. The extension holds no documents itself: each call is forwarded to the running studio, which saves every edit and shows it in its window.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List the documents in the project open in ChalkScript Studio, with each one's hash and counts of errors and warnings.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a document, or the part of it at a JSON Pointer such as /steps/trade. The first line of the result is the document's hash, which edit takes as its base.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Change a document by JSON Patch (RFC 6902) made against its current hash. Every operation applies or none does. Returns the new hash and counts of findings, or why the patch was refused.

tools.name: check
tools.description: List a document's errors and warnings, one per line, or only those under a JSON Pointer.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Play a step in the studio window: the first without step, the current problem without problem. Returns its timeline. With image, also a picture of its end, at ratio (width/height) or the window's shape.

tools.name: create
tools.description: Make a new explainer from a title and show it in the window. Its name comes from the title; name sets one, from copies a document. Returns the document to patch; read guide topic new first.

tools.name: guide
tools.description: Read the authoring guide to the explainer format and how to edit it. Without a topic, its list of topics.
